plan.summary: This 1-4 block is an off-camp boxing S&C phase built around bodyweight-only strength, power, and enough conditioning to support the work. Week 1 establishes baselines on the main primary movements so future progress is easy to track, and the main training starts in Week 2. The block keeps power first, then strength, then accessories, then conditioning, with volume kept practical so it fits alongside boxing work.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general strength and power with simple bodyweight patterns and repeatable conditioning.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress unilateral strength, explosive output, and trunk stiffness while keeping fatigue recoverable.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep strength in place and express it with faster boxing-relevant power and sharper conditioning.

exercises.name: 1a. Squat Jump
exercises.notes: Jump as high as you can on every rep. Land softly and reset between reps.

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if squat jumps bother the knees or landings get heavy.

exercises.name: 1b. Rotational Shadowbox Throw
exercises.notes: Throw the hips and shoulders fast as if punching through the target. Stay balanced and crisp.

substitutionOptions.name: Explosive Cross-Body Mountain Climber
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if space is limited. Drive each side sharply without losing trunk position.

exercises.name: 2. Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
exercises.notes: Warm up with a few easy build-up sets, then work up to your hardest clean set of 3-5 reps each side using tempo or a loaded backpack if needed. Log the reps and setup used so this becomes your baseline.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your hardest clean set of 3-5 reps per side. Log the reps and setup so the app can track your baseline for future progress.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track the heaviest clean top set per side with the exact setup you used.

substitutionOptions.name: Front-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you do not have a stable rear-foot support.

substitutionOptions.name: Tempo Split Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a 4-second lowering phase if bodyweight alone is too easy.

exercises.name: 3. Single-Leg Glute Bridge
exercises.notes: Pause for 2 seconds at the top and keep the ribs down.

substitutionOptions.name: Hamstring Walkout
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you want more hamstring demand without equipment.

exercises.name: 4. Strict Leg Raise
exercises.notes: Move slowly, keep the low back under control, and do not swing.

substitutionOptions.name: Reverse Crunch
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if full leg raises are too hard to control.

exercises.name: 5. Neck Flexion Isometric
exercises.notes: Use your hands for light resistance and keep the effort smooth, not maximal.

substitutionOptions.name: Supine Towel Neck Hold
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if hand-resisted work feels awkward.

exercises.name: 6. Tempo Running Intervals
exercises.notes: Run 8 rounds of 45 seconds at a steady hard pace with 45 seconds easy walk. Stay smooth and keep the pace repeatable.

exercises.name: 1a. Plyo Push-Up
exercises.notes: Explode off the floor with clean reps. Stop if height drops or the landing gets sloppy.

substitutionOptions.name: Hands-Off Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if true plyo push-ups are not sharp enough yet.

exercises.name: 1b. Fast Straight-Punch Shadowboxing
exercises.notes: Throw straight punches as fast as possible while staying loose and clean.

substitutionOptions.name: Fast Punch-Outs
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a shorter range and higher speed if shoulders fatigue quickly.

exercises.name: 2. Feet-Elevated Push-Up
exercises.notes: Warm up with easier push-up variations, then work up to your hardest clean set of 3-5 reps. Use backpack loading or slower tempo if needed and log the exact setup.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your hardest clean set of 3-5 reps. Log the reps and exact setup so the app can track your pressing baseline.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track your best clean top set and keep the setup consistent each time.

substitutionOptions.name: Close-Grip Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you do not have a stable elevation for the feet.

substitutionOptions.name: Tempo Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a 4-second lowering phase if bodyweight loading is too light.

exercises.name: 3. Towel Row Isometric
exercises.notes: Loop a towel around a solid anchor or post, lean back, and pull hard with a packed shoulder position.

substitutionOptions.name: Table Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you have a sturdy table and can set up safely.

exercises.name: 4. Pike Push-Up
exercises.notes: Keep the hips high and lower under control toward the hands.

substitutionOptions.name: Wall Handstand Hold
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if shoulder pressing strength is not ready for full reps.

exercises.name: 5. Side Plank
exercises.notes: Stack the body straight and keep the hips up the whole time.

substitutionOptions.name: Copenhagen Side Plank
substitutionOptions.notes: Use the short-lever version if you want more adductor demand.

exercises.name: 6. Shuttle Intervals
exercises.notes: Run 10 rounds of 15 seconds hard and 45 seconds easy. Turn under control and keep the hard bouts fast but repeatable.

exercises.name: 1a. Broad Jump
exercises.notes: Jump far with a clean stick on the landing. Reset each rep.

substitutionOptions.name: Box Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you have a stable box and want lower landing stress.

exercises.name: 1b. Sprawl to Stance Reset
exercises.notes: Move fast but stay tidy. Hit the floor under control and stand back into a clean stance.

substitutionOptions.name: Burpee to Athletic Stance
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if a full sprawl is not practical.

exercises.name: 2. Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Warm up with easy balance reps, then build to your hardest strict set of 3-5 reps each side using backpack loading or slow tempo if needed. Log the exact setup.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your hardest strict set of 3-5 reps per side. Log the reps and setup so the app can track your hinge baseline.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track the best strict top set per side with the same setup.

substitutionOptions.name: Hip Airplane Hold
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if balance is the main limiter and you need a simpler hinge pattern.

substitutionOptions.name: Backpack Good Morning
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if single-leg balance is too inconsistent to assess cleanly.

exercises.name: 3. Bear Crawl
exercises.notes: Move with short controlled steps and keep the trunk stiff.

substitutionOptions.name: Beast Hold Shoulder Tap
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if space is tight.

exercises.name: 4. Push-Up
exercises.notes: Leave 1-2 clean reps in reserve and keep the body rigid.

substitutionOptions.name: Close-Grip Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you want a triceps-heavy option.

exercises.name: 5. Hollow Body Hold
exercises.notes: Keep the low back pressed down and breathe shallowly through the hold.

substitutionOptions.name: Dead Bug Hold
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if the full hollow position is too aggressive.

exercises.name: 6. Continuous Roadwork
exercises.notes: Run or skip continuously for 20-25 minutes at a steady conversational pace. Finish feeling better than when you started.
